changes.title: Bold sigils
items: A first look at bolder sigils, easier to read in your stack: add ?sigils=bold to the link (cat, lynx, owl, bear and boar so far)

changes.title: Pause debug
items: The pause page has ⬇ Download log (the L key is gone) and a debug switch, 🔓 Unlock everything: every outfit, bag, broom part, hat and island to choose while it's on, without counting any of it as found

changes.title: Hide shadow
items: Animals slipping away between attacks (into the trees, underground, under water, or scattering) now show as a dark see-through shadow of themselves running round, fading in and out, instead of vanishing
